// Ambient speech content: who can speak, where they appear, and what they say when nobody has asked them anything.
// Pure data (no DOM, no imports). src/ambient-speech.mjs chooses from it; src/ambient-bubbles.mjs draws it.
// Voice rules live in docs/voice/bridge-crew.md (robots) and docs/ambient-speech.md (everyone else). In short:
// cozy, never cruel; the player is "Overseer" or "you", never "he" or "she"; plain ASCII (the bitmap font has no
// curly quotes); at most AMBIENT_LINE_MAX characters so a bubble stays small on a phone.
//
// The shapes follow docs/dialog-contract.md so a later phase can validate this file with validateContract:
//   speaker = {id, name, role, kind:'character', portrait, voice}     (id /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/, name <= 16, role <= 24)
//   line    = {id, text, kind, places?, stages?, when?, near?, mood?}
//     kind   'quip' | 'musing' | 'observation' | 'hum' | 'overseer' (a remark about the Overseer)
//     places rooms/places the line fits: 'bridge' 'hub' 'kitchen' 'workshop' 'dock' 'cinder' 'rime' (default: everywhere the speaker stands)
//     stages story chapters it fits: 'c0' the opening garden, 'c1' first propulsion, 'c2' a home in motion (default: all)
//     when   a dialog-contract condition read against the game state ({flag:'motion.cruising'}), data only
//     near   'player' (the speaker stands close to the player) or 'garden-ready' (a crop is ready to harvest)
//     mood   'bright' (the first two thirds of the day) or 'quiet' (the evening)
//   exchange = {id, a, b, lines:[{speaker,text},{speaker,text}], places?, stages?, when?}   two bubbles, one after the other

export const AMBIENT_LINE_MAX = 96;
export const KINDS = Object.freeze(['quip', 'musing', 'observation', 'hum', 'overseer']);
export const PLACES = Object.freeze(['bridge', 'hub', 'kitchen', 'workshop', 'dock', 'cinder', 'rime']);
export const STAGES = Object.freeze(['c0', 'c1', 'c2']);
export const NEAR_TAGS = Object.freeze(['player', 'garden-ready']);
export const MOODS = Object.freeze(['bright', 'quiet']);

const ALL = ['c0', 'c1', 'c2'];
const person = (id, name, role, appears) => Object.freeze({ id, name, role, kind: 'character', portrait: id, voice: `${id}-voice`, appears });

// appears: where the world draws this speaker, and in which story stages they are there (the bridge robots wake at saved milestones).
export const SPEAKERS = Object.freeze({
  tally: person('tally', 'TALLY-4', 'Cargo clerk', [{ place: 'bridge', stages: ['c1', 'c2'] }]),
  vector: person('vector', 'VECTOR-2', 'Navigator', [{ place: 'bridge', stages: ['c1', 'c2'] }]),
  cap: person('cap', 'CAP-0', 'Watch coordinator', [{ place: 'bridge', stages: ['c2'] }]),
  pip: person('pip', 'PIP', 'Cook', [{ place: 'kitchen', stages: ALL }]),
  mara: person('mara', 'MARA', 'Shipwright', [{ place: 'workshop', stages: ALL }]),
  sprocket: person('sprocket', 'SPROCKET', 'Farm droid', [{ place: 'hub', stages: ALL }]),
  nine: person('nine', 'NINE', 'Field science', [{ place: 'hub', stages: ALL }, { place: 'cinder', stages: ['c1', 'c2'] }, { place: 'rime', stages: ['c2'] }]),
  nori: person('nori', 'NORI', 'Young resident', [{ place: 'hub', stages: ALL }]),
  vey: person('vey', 'VEY', 'Visiting wayfinder', [{ place: 'hub', stages: ALL }]),
  tavi: person('tavi', 'TAVI', 'Courier', [{ place: 'dock', stages: ALL }]),
  ilex: person('ilex', 'ILEX', 'Cinder grower', [{ place: 'cinder', stages: ['c1', 'c2'] }]),
  sen: person('sen', 'SEN', 'Seedling keeper', [{ place: 'rime', stages: ['c2'] }]),
});

const L = (id, kind, text, tags = {}) => Object.freeze({ id, kind, text, ...tags });
const f = flag => ({ flag });

// Robot-to-robot (and other) two-bubble exchanges. The first speaker talks; the second answers once the first has finished.
const X = (id, a, b, first, second, tags = {}) => Object.freeze({ id, a, b, lines: Object.freeze([Object.freeze({ speaker: a, text: first }), Object.freeze({ speaker: b, text: second })]), ...tags });
export const EXCHANGES = Object.freeze([
  X('x-vector-cap-morale', 'vector', 'cap', 'Captain. Core temperature nominal. Morale unmeasured.', 'Morale is excellent. I have no data. That is how I know.'),
  X('x-tally-vector-nut', 'tally', 'vector', 'VECTOR-2, I require a bearing for the missing wing nut.', 'It is in your left manipulator. Bearing: down. Distance: zero.'),
  X('x-cap-vector-calm', 'cap', 'vector', 'VECTOR-2, route us somewhere calm.', 'Calm is not a coordinate. I can offer low drainage and no comets.'),
  X('x-tally-cap-hat', 'tally', 'cap', 'Captain, the colander hat is a ventilation fixture. I must file it as such.', 'It is a ceremonial hat. Strike that from the record.'),
  X('x-vector-tally-way', 'vector', 'tally', 'TALLY-4, your inventory is in my way.', 'My inventory is in its assigned place. Your way is in the wrong place.'),
  X('x-cap-tally-survive', 'cap', 'tally', 'We can survive in space, you know. Unlike the precious organics.', 'Noted. They also survive soup. This is not in my manual.'),
  X('x-tally-cap-fondness', 'tally', 'cap', 'Captain, I filed Form 7-F today. Subject: fondness. Subject of subject: the humans.', 'Shred it. No. Keep it. Seal it. Do not tell them. They would be insufferable.'),
  X('x-vector-cap-charts', 'vector', 'cap', 'Captain, I have refreshed the charts. They were stale.', 'Of course they were stale. Everything was. Carry on, navigator.', { stages: ['c2'] }),
  X('x-cap-vector-cruise', 'cap', 'vector', 'Navigator. Are we still moving?', 'Confirmed. Sustained cruise. You may stop checking. You will not.', { stages: ['c2'], when: f('motion.cruising') }),
]);

// All lines for one speaker as a flat list (data only; the selector filters by tag).
export const poolFor = id => POOLS[id] ?? [];
export const allLines = () => Object.entries(POOLS).flatMap(([speaker, lines]) => lines.map(line => ({ ...line, speaker })));
